title: Restricted-edge reachability is contained in full-edge reachability (edge-monotonicity)
explanation: The program computes graph reachability from a root set RootN restricted to "hard" (non-optional) edges only, modeling the analysis a dependency resolver like npm's Arborist uses to decide which packages keep a required (non-optional) dependency path from the root. The Hoare triple is a containment claim rather than full equivalence: the precondition makes RBound a pre-fixpoint of the reachability operator over the unrestricted edge set EdgeAll, and the postcondition asserts the hard-edge-only reachable set NonOpt is contained in RBound, i.e. contained in full-edge reachability, the standard edge-monotonicity fact that removing edges (here, optional ones) can only shrink what is reachable.
preInWords: The precondition asserts RBound contains RootN and is closed under one more step of reachability through the full edge set EdgeAll, i.e. RBound is a pre-fixpoint of full-edge reachability.
postInWords: The postcondition asserts the hard-edge-restricted reachable set NonOpt is contained in RBound.

NonOptC(x1) :- RootN(x1).
NonOptC(y1) :- NonOptC(x1), EdgeHardC(x1, y1).
